depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble with bottom-left tail
depiction.composition: single object with centered symbol, flat outline

ambiguity: At small sizes the X can look like a plus rotated, or the whole icon can resemble a backspace key or close-window button.

modifier_semantics.meaning: delete, remove, close, disable, or error

reasoning: Shows a rectangular speech bubble containing an X mark, clearly meaning delete message, remove comment, or disable chat. It fits specific cleanup and moderation tasks well, though general messaging tasks need an unmarked speech bubble.
